name.km: ខម្រេចសាច់ទា

description: A peppery caramel braise heavy with cracked Kampot black pepper.
descriptionKm: ខម្រេច — ផ្សំជាមួយម្រេចកំពត។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងធ្ងន់

ingredients.itemKm: ម្រេចខ្មៅកំពត
ទឹកដូងខ្ចី

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Melt the palm sugar in a heavy pot until it caramelises to a deep amber.
instructions.tip: Take the caramel just to amber — too dark and it turns bitter.

instructions.text: Add the smashed garlic and the duck (chopped into pieces); turn to coat in the caramel.
Add fish sauce and the braising liquid, plus the other aromatics.
Cover and braise gently until until tender and the sauce is syrupy, about 45 minutes.
Uncover and reduce until glossy and clinging.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
